decisions.statement: A landing path under no TypeScript name is refused here.
Nothing here judges the path a file is moved from.
A path with no body is refused rather than moved.
A path a body already sits at is refused rather than written over.
The file is moved by the change this change reaches.
The body moved names its own imports by the paths its new folder reaches.
The module repointing a body is called rather than reached through a rung.
Every body importing the file names the path that file landed at.
An index naming no importer of the file moves that file and repoints nothing.
Nothing here works out a body of its own.
A generated body importing what moved is written by the generator.

definition: one code file moved to another path, with every body importing it repointed
